name: Clock
description: Alarms and timers, set in the window or by your agent.
about: A clock with a live analog face, alarms on drum wheels, and a countdown timer. Set an alarm yourself or let an agent set one for itself, and when it goes off it wakes whichever agents it was set for, which you choose when you create it. Timers work the same way from either side and both of you watch the same countdown. Closing the window does not stop the clock. It keeps running in the background, so an alarm you set this morning still goes off this afternoon.

commands.name: list
commands.about: list all alarms and timers (shows who each wakes)

commands.name: alarm
commands.about: set an alarm at a wall-clock time; --note is your prompt for the turn it wakes, --repeat daily|weekdays|weekends|mon,wed,fri, --to picks which agent(s) it wakes, --quiet fires as context without a turn

commands.name: edit
commands.about: change an alarm; omitted flags keep their value (--time --label --note --repeat --quiet --wake --to)

commands.name: timer
commands.about: start a countdown (10m, 1h30m, 90s) — fires timer.done when it ends

commands.name: set
commands.about: shorthand: a clock time makes an alarm, a duration a timer

commands.name: hide
commands.about: send it back to the background — the alarms keep running

commands.name: close
commands.about: quit the app — this is what stops the alarms
